description: This file defines the 'Thing' interface in Java for the Eclipse Ditto project. It encompasses a comprehensive API for modeling, modifying, and managing 'Thing' entities, including attributes, features, lifecycle, security policies, and serialization fields.

classes.name: Thing.JsonFields
classes.description: This nested static class provides definitions for the JSON fields used in serializing and deserializing Thing objects, including schema version, lifecycle, namespace, revision, timestamps, identifiers, ACL, policy, attributes, features, and metadata.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for constructing a Thing instance from scratch.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a mutable builder initialized with the current state of this Thing instance for modifications.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the applicable JSON schema version for this Thing, depending on its access control and policy presence.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the namespace in which this Thing was created.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the attributes associated with this Thing.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Returns a copy of this Thing with the specified attributes set.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Returns a copy of this Thing with all attributes removed.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the optional entity ID of this Thing.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute at the given path with the provided JsonValue, returning a new modified Thing.

methods.name: setAttribute (overload for boolean)
methods.description: Sets a boolean attribute at the specified path.

methods.name: setAttribute (overload for int)
methods.description: Sets an integer attribute at the specified path.

methods.name: setAttribute (overload for long)
methods.description: Sets a long attribute at the specified path.

methods.name: setAttribute (overload for double)
methods.description: Sets a double attribute at the specified path.

methods.name: setAttribute (overload for String)
methods.description: Sets a string attribute at the specified path.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Core method to set attribute at a JsonPointer path.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes the attribute at the specified path, returning an updated Thing.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the optional ThingDefinition associated with this Thing.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition identifier, returning an updated Thing.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition, returning an updated Thing.

methods.name: setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Associates a feature definition with a specific feature ID.

methods.name: removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes the feature definition associated with a specific feature ID.

methods.name: setFeatureProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a feature by ID.

methods.name: setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a property within a feature, identified by ID and path.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperties
methods.description: Removes all properties of a specified feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property within a feature by ID and path.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Retrieves the current lifecycle status of this Thing.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle status, returning an updated Thing.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if this Thing has the specified lifecycle status.

methods.name: getAccessControlList
methods.description: Retrieves the optional ACL associated with this Thing.

methods.name: setAccessControlList
methods.description: Sets a new ACL, replacing existing policies and ID.

methods.name: setAclEntry
methods.description: Sets or overwrites a specific ACL entry.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions for a given authorization subject.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns the deprecated string Policy ID, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: setPolicyId
methods.description: Sets the deprecated string Policy ID.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the typed PolicyId of the Thing.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves the optional set of features associated with this Thing.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets the features of this Thing.

methods.name: removeFeatures
methods.description: Removes all features from this Thing.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or replaces a feature.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Deprecated method that does nothing; IDs are validated elsewhere.
